title: A positions grid with computed, coloured P&L
prompt: In src/App.svelte, show the positions from src/positions.ts in a grid with the columns Symbol, Qty, Avg price, Last and P&L, where P&L is qty × (last − avg). The columns should be sortable, and P&L should show in green when it is positive and red when it is negative.

idioms.name: computes P&L in the column (value), not by copying rows
